pages.heading: Mantis Shrimp
pages.body: Warm reefs and mangrove swamps. Neutral, with a powerful block-breaking punch. Tame with tropical fish, heal with fish, and breed with Lobster

pages.heading: Mantis Shrimp (cont.)
pages.body: Tails. Sneak-use a water bucket to keep a tame shrimp from drying out. Give it a block while sneaking, then select block-breaking behavior to target matching blocks.
